question: What will the total domestic (US/Canada) box office gross be for Q4 2026?

calls.reasoning: Box Office Mojo shows Q4 2026 at $369M through Oct 19, already 86% of all of Oct 2025 ($429M); October likely ends ~$520-560M. Post-COVID Q4s ran $1.77-2.35B; pre-COVID ~$2.9B. December carries Avengers: Doomsday + Dune: Part Three (Dec 18; 14 in-quarter days incl. Christmas), Doomsday presales reported ~65% ahead of Spider-Man BND ($360M opening), plus Jumanji (Dec 11) and Hunger Games prequel (Nov 20). November is weaker than 2025's Wicked/Zootopia 2. Cinelytic projects ~$2.4B; bottom-up sum gives ~$2.4-2.6B. No human market found on this quantity (MediaPredict prices Doomsday opening ~$303M; Polymarket only on biggest opening weekend).

- BOM (as of Oct 19 2026): Q4 2026 to date $369.1M. October full-month totals: 2025 $429M, 2024 $463M, 2023 $556M, 2022 $469M, 2019 $782M.
- BOM Q4 totals: 2025 $2.189B, 2024 $2.350B, 2023 $1.857B, 2022 $1.775B, 2021 $2.068B, 2019 $2.889B, 2018 $2.951B, 2017 $2.895B, 2016 $2.808B, 2015 $2.911B. Post-COVID mean ~$2.05B; pre-COVID mean ~$2.89B.

- 2026 context: Summer 2026 record $4.76B (Deadline, Sep 2026); Spider-Man: Brand New Day $958M domestic, opened $360M; The Odyssey $625M.
- Cinelytic (Oct 6 2026): projects Q4 2026 ~$2.4B, 'best Q4 since 2019'; claims 94% YTD accuracy. A Substack piece projects 2026 year ~$10B with $0.4B upside if 'Dunesday' performs like Barbenheimer.
- Dec slate: Jumanji: Open World Dec 11; Avengers: Doomsday + Dune: Part Three Dec 18 (Dune holds exclusive IMAX through holidays; Doomsday has no IMAX domestically); Angry Birds 3, Violent Night 2, Werwulf (Christmas, Cinelytic proj ~$88M total).
- Doomsday: $16.5M first-day premium presales (Variety); TheWrap (Aug 2026) says presales ~65% ahead of Spider-Man BND pace; projections cited range $230-260M opening (KSL roundup), MediaPredict market ~$303M opening. Comparable: Spider-Man NWH (Dec 17 2021, $260M opening) earned roughly $580M by Dec 31.
- Nov slate: Godzilla Minus Zero (Nov 6, GKIDS), Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping (Nov 20, tracking $60-70M+ opening), Hexed (Disney animation) and Focker-In-Law (Nov 25), Ebenezer, Clayface (~$26M opening proj). Narnia theatrical moved to Feb 2027.
- October 2026 weekends: Verity $32M (Oct 2), Other Mommy $27.8M (Oct 9-11), Street Fighter $30.8M (Oct 16).
- Downside risks: Doomsday/Dune cannibalization, a date shift out of December, weak November vs 2025's Wicked/Zootopia pair. Upside: Barbenheimer-style dual event, Doomsday record opening.
- Searched for but not found: any Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold/bookmaker market on Q4 or yearly domestic total (none found); Oct 1-19 2025 comparison figure.
